---
title: "Rolling local-support assayable universe"
output: html_document
---

Proteins were considered locally assayable when they were supported by both
peer studies in a centred three-study window. Proteins detected in the held-out
study were retained so that the denominator did not exclude observed proteins.
The script checks these rules at the protein-by-study level and summarizes the
resulting assayable universe for each of the 21 derivation studies.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
repo <- if (dir.exists("../scripts")) normalizePath("..") else normalizePath(".")
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = repo)
source(file.path(repo, "scripts", "02_assayable_universe.R"))
```

```{r results}
read.delim("analysis/02_assayable_universe/study_assayable_universes.tsv", check.names = FALSE)
```

The figure is written to
`analysis/02_assayable_universe/assayable_universe.pdf`.
